subject: Plotting points using different colors in ascending order using ggplot2

messages.author: 860d1b0d3a763a0e
messages.subject: Plotting points using different colors in ascending order using ggplot2
parts:
Hi everyone,

I want to plot the species richness values of various plots on my map. However, I am struggling to apply different colours to the different points I have so far plotted. How can I get to color the points in the legend and on the map? See my seprodecable code. Attached is my current map and species richness csv file.  I would really appreciate any help on this.

library(ggplot2)
library(raster)
require("rgdal")
library(tidyverse)                              
library(sf)                                      
library(maptools)

Medicinal_richness<- read.csv("data/Preparing_all_data_2022/Prepared_richness/species_richness_tables/final_prepared_richness/thinned_medicinal_plants.csv", header = T, sep = ",", dec=".")

head(Medicinal_richness)
max(Medicinal_richness$Richness)
min(Medicinal_richness$Richness)

Kenya <- getData('GADM', country='Kenya', level=1) #Extracion de Peru
#Kenya_no_counties <- getData('GADM', country='Kenya', level=0) #Extracion de Peru
plot(Kenya)
class(Kenya)

Samburu_county <-Kenya[Kenya@data$NAME_1 == "Samburu",]
plot(Samburu_county)
Samburu_county_df<-fortify(Samburu_county)


plot2_best <- ggplot() + geom_polygon(data=Samburu_county_df, aes(long, lat, group = group), fill = NA, colour = "black") +  xlab("") + ylab("") + geom_point(data=Medicinal_richness, aes(x = long, y = lat, size=Richness)) + scale_size(name = "Total Richness", breaks=c(1,3,6,9,12,15,18), limits = c(2,18), labels=c("1-3 spp", "3-6 spp", "6-9 spp", "9-12 spp", "12-15 spp", "15-18 spp", "18-21 spp")) + theme(legend.position=c(.08,0.83)) ; plot2_best
